notes:
EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), mbedtls: library/bignum_core.c through library/ripemd160.c. These 128 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 92 FP, 36 TP.

FP shapes: PSA slot getters that give a non-null slot on every success return, read after the status test; closed static caller chains (psa_finish_key_creation and the key-agreement and derivation internals); walks over static arrays (ecp_supported_curves, ecp_supported_grp_id). TP shapes: parameters of non-static library functions with no test (bignum core, ecdh, ecp key export, md5/ripemd160 update input, PSA buffer and key-data helpers); SE driver methods stored by the public psa_register_se_driver (medium, consistent with coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto). psa_crypto_slot_management.c:1084 is TP medium: psa_purge_key's in-memory lookup does not check that the key store is initialized.

24 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
